messages.author: AndyTheHusky
messages.text:
As it stands, the UI is not the most userfriendly  in the world. There are things hidden within things, like how the Policies are nested in the Edit tab.

I'd like to make things a little easier for everyone by suggesting that things be organized in a sidebar like the 2nd image. Bold items can be dropdowns except for the big ol Affairs and Order. 

For mobile users, the sidebar would hidden by a button, pressing that button reveals the sidebar.

If the 2nd image doesn't really do it,  then think of PnW's interface or DnS. PnW has an organized sidebar, DnS has an organized top bar.

It's also be nice if we can either see our resources via a topbar dropdown or the dollar button we have now.

Thats really it. 
**This is mostly a QOL thing everybody is free to add on to.** Because personally, UI is the biggest fish we have to fry.

messages.author: AndyTheHusky
messages.text: ps 1: Forgot to talk about an optional resources dropdown from the top bar. Players can choose between button and topbar dropdown.

messages.author: AndyTheHusky
messages.text:
ps 2: i thought of a **national statistics tab** too, under  "nation", where we can see important stuff like age demographics/population pyramid, growth rate, total educational attainment and whatnot.

Maybe flavor stuff too, like gdp, gdp/capita, hdi and shit, but that's not really important. the end goal is decluttering.

messages.author: AndyTheHusky
messages.text:
ps 3: a **national character** tab in the future could be nice too. that's where the deeper larp goes. overview would only show surface-level larping.

some events could also give you "national spirits" (haha hoi4 infested brain) that give you effects as long as the "spirit" exists, like raised baseline happiness, raised growth rate % or a fixed-number, non negotiable growth rate.

messages.author: AndyTheHusky
messages.text:
ps4: **achievements tab** maybe??

"there's no limit to the larp" - have a total of 10,000 or more words in your national lore

messages.author: AndyTheHusky
messages.text: **ps 5: the PS'es are not included in the actual suggestion.**

messages.author: Andrew
messages.text: Also, maybe a sliding bar in the options menu to let us select how large gaps should be, so we can make things closer together. IDK about anyone else, maybe my screen is tiny, but it feels like most things are just really big and spaced out such that not much information is ever on the screen at one time, IE I have to scroll around a LOT for most things which aren't at the top of any given page.
